topics.title: Number Bases, Modular Arithmetic, Fractions, Indices, Logarithms, Sets, Logic, Surds, Matrices, Ratios, Percentages, and Financial Arithmetic

subtopics.content: Base conversions, modulo operations, fractions/decimals, standard form, laws of indices, logarithm tables, set operations, Venn diagrams, logical statements, simple surd operations, 2x2 matrices, ratios, proportions, financial calculations, variations
subtopics.objective: Convert between number bases and perform basic base arithmetic; solve modular arithmetic problems; apply approximation and significant figures; evaluate expressions using laws of indices and logarithms; solve set problems using Venn diagrams; evaluate logical statements; simplify and rationalize simple surds; perform $2\times2$ matrix operations and determinants; calculate ratios, rates, simple/compound interest, depreciation, annuities, and variation problems.

topics.title: Algebraic Expressions, Linear/Quadratic Equations, Subject of Formula, Inequalities, Fractions, and Functions

subtopics.content: Algebraic formulation, expansion, factorization, binary operations, linear equations, simultaneous linear equations, formula subject change, quadratic factorization/formula, graphs of quadratic functions, linear inequalities, algebraic fractions, mapping functions
subtopics.objective: Formulate, expand, and factorize algebraic expressions; execute binary operations; solve linear and simultaneous linear equations; change the subject of a formula; solve quadratic equations by factoring, completing the square, or formula; plot linear and quadratic graphs to obtain roots and gradients; solve linear inequalities in 1 or 2 variables; simplify algebraic fractions; identify mappings and function rules.

topics.title: Mensuration, Plane Geometry, Geometric Constructions, Loci, and Coordinate Geometry

subtopics.content: Perimeters, arc lengths, areas of plane shapes/sectors, surface areas and volumes of 3D solids (cubes, cylinders, cones, spheres), latitude/longitude, angle properties, parallel lines, triangle/polygon properties, circle theorems, geometric constructions, 2D loci, straight line coordinate geometry
subtopics.objective: Calculate arc lengths, perimeters, plane areas, and 3D surface areas/volumes; calculate distances along latitudes and longitudes; apply geometric angle rules, triangle congruence, polygon sum of angles, and circle theorems; construct bisectors, angles, triangles, and quadrilaterals; determine 2D loci intersections; calculate line midpoints, distances, gradients, and straight line equations.

sections.sectionTitle: Section D: Trigonometry, Calculus, Statistics, Probability, Vectors & Transformations

topics.title: Trigonometric Ratios, Bearings, Introductory Calculus, Statistics, Probability, Vectors, and Transformations

subtopics.content: Sine/Cosine/Tangent ratios, trigonometric graphs, angles of elevation/depression, bearings, basic differentiation/integration, frequency tables, Ogives, mean/median/mode, standard deviation, classical probability, vector operations, Cartesian transformations
subtopics.objective: Apply basic trigonometric ratios ($30^\circ, 45^\circ, 60^\circ$) and solve elevation/depression/bearing problems; differentiate basic algebraic functions and evaluate simple definite integrals; construct frequency tables, histograms, pie charts, and Ogives; calculate measures of central tendency and dispersion (range, mean deviation, standard deviation); calculate simple and compound probabilities; represent vectors and perform vector operations; execute Cartesian reflections, rotations, translations, and enlargements.
